title: Chaar Su Koun o Makaa Me Wa Hassan ki Hai Sada
body:
Char soo koun o makan me wa Hassan ki hai sada
Kam suqan moula ko mere zeher e zalim ne diya
Peete hi ek ghoont pani hogaya tukdey jigar
Tha asar aisa badan sub neel goon hone laga.
<<DIVIDER>>
Is qadar takleef thi moula Hassan ko us ghadi
Loot te the farsh par darde jigar se mujtaba
Kar ke bhai ko wasiyath chal basa zehra ka lal
Dekh te hi dekh te ghar bangaya matam sara
<<DIVIDER>>
Soonp kar Qasim ko Sarwar say kaha aye bhai jaan
Karbala mein mera Qasim hoyega fidya mera
